subject: ScaleVision PoC - request to increase onboarding credits for large-context workload
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@scalevision.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@scalevision.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: ScaleVision PoC profile and ask for additional onboarding credits

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick demo earlier — the team is excited. We ran a short internal analysis and it looks like our evaluation will need to exercise 150k TPM with frequent 200k+ token context windows (document-level retrieval + multi-document summaries). Given that footprint, our initial self-serve credits look likely to be exhausted within days.

Attached is a compact profile of the PoC (scalevision_poc_profile.csv) with expected traffic patterns. Can Redwood consider a one-time increase to the onboarding grant to cover a 30-day PoC so we can validate throughput/accounting? We plan to convert to Dedicated if numbers look good.

Key asks: 1) increase credits sufficient for 150k TPM for 30 days, 2) a short extension to the 30-day window if we hit early milestones, and 3) a link to the precise trial usage dashboard for billing visibility.

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

— Priya
Head of Data Products
ScaleVision
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@scalevision.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: ScaleVision PoC profile and ask for additional onboarding credits

Priya —

Appreciate the detailed profile. We can definitely support larger context PoCs but need internal approval because this is above the standard self-serve grant. I’ve looped in Neha (growth) and Ben (sales ops) to scope the uplift and confirm logistics.

Two quick clarifications that will help speed approval: 1) confirm the expected peak TPM per minute and an estimated token consumption per API call (rough average), and 2) confirm whether you need the credits as hosted API units or if you are planning to test on a Dedicated trial.

I’ve attached your CSV to this thread for reference.

Best,
Mina
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: ScaleVision PoC profile and ask for additional onboarding credits

Mina / Ben —

Reviewed the profile. This is clearly outside our default starter allowance. Recommendation: approve a timebound top-up equal to ~2.5M generated tokens (covers 150k TPM sustained bursts for ~30 days with buffer). Ask: Cap the grant to hosted API only, and require billing card on file + MoP signed (we have the signed-mop-template.pdf ready). Also propose the following tiered fallback: if usage exceeds 3M tokens in the first 14 days, we auto-pause and require a joint call.

I think this is low risk but we should record in the console and make the reduction conditions explicit. Lauren, any objections?

— Neha
Growth Lead, Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: ScaleVision PoC profile and ask for additional onboarding credits

Thumbs up from me. Approve the 2.5M token top-up to hosted API for 30 days with the safeguards Neha outlined. Please document the guardrails in the PoC record and send the customer the terms + the console link. Ben, take the action to provision and attach the DocuSign MoP.

— Lauren
VP, Sales Operations
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@scalevision.ai>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:29:00 -05:00
Subject: ScaleVision PoC - onboarding credit issued (2.5M tokens)

Hi Priya —

Good news: we’ve issued a one-time onboarding top-up of 2,500,000 generated-token units to ScaleVision’s account. Scope and guardrails: hosted API only; valid for 30 days from issuance; automatic pause if consumption exceeds 3,000,000 tokens in the first 14 days.

Actions completed: 1) MoP sent via DocuSign (DocuSign:0b1f3a9f-ScaleVision-MoP), 2) billing card requirement added to account, 3) PoC record updated in Console (https://app.redwood.ai/console/accounts/scalevision/poc/rdw-4582).

Attachments: signed-mop-template.pdf (stub — final signed copy to follow).

If you want us to extend the window mid-PoC, reply with the milestone you expect to hit and we’ll fast-track a review.

Talk soon —
Ben Carter
